title: ISO Certification
content: [vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="ISO (International Organization for Standardization)"]ISO is a universal standard that can help any organization/ institution certified with the Quality Management System(QMS). A quality management structure which gives the system to inspect the performance of the different departments of the institution like utilization of complete resources, client satisfaction, market share, cost reduction and many more. ATME College of Engineering was first assessed by the AJA Registrars in the year 2013 and was first registered against the requirements of ISO 9001-2008 on December 10th, 2013. Year on year ATME College of Engineering has gone under Surveillance Audit and assessed by AJA Registrars. Recently in the year 2018, ATME College of Engineering was assessed by the AJA Registrars against the requirements of ISO 9001-2015 and have got Certificate of Registration Dated 02nd May 2018.   Click here to view ISO Certificate[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row]
